# Amey's Arc

> Amey's Arc is a working archive of research and engineering notes: derivations carried through in full, close readings of papers, and project records kept as first written. Published while the work is in progress.

Author: Amey Thakur (https://github.com/Amey-Thakur)
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5644-1575

## Reading the site

- Posts index: https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/
- Machine-readable index (JSON): https://amey-thakur.github.io/index.json
- Feed (RSS): https://amey-thakur.github.io/index.xml
- Sitemap: https://amey-thakur.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Notes for crawlers

All content on this site is written by the author and may be indexed. Each post
carries schema.org JSON-LD with authorship and publication dates. The canonical
URL for every page is declared in its head.
